entities.summary: The Monasticon Gallicanum is a collection of 168 engravings of topographical views, with two maps, representing 147 French monasteries belonging to the reformist Benedictine Congregation of St. Maur. Commissioned by Dom Michel Germain, the engravings were prepared between 1675 and 1694, but not published in full until 1870.
